articles.title: Mariners’ Cole Young making compelling push for AL Gold Glove award
articles.description: Cole Young, 23, has appeared in all but one of the Mariners’ games this season, and he has put himself in the conversation for the American League Gold Glove award at second base.

articles.title: Mariners beat Rangers as Seahawks fever takes over T-Mobile Park
articles.description: The Mariners' 3-2 win over the Rangers, featuring the best outing of rookie Kade Anderson's young career, was relegated to a sidenote to the Seahawks' opener.

articles.title: Mariners suffer through another painful loss to Athletics
articles.description: Just about everything that has tormented the Mariners this season occurred in microcosm during Saturday’s 6-2 loss to the Athletics.

articles.title: Yes, the Mariners can still make the playoffs. But common sense says otherwise.
articles.description: The math says it’s possible for the Mariners to make the playoffs. But nothing about this team indicates they have a miracle run in them to reach October.

articles.title: Bryan Woo’s career-best start helps Mariners avoid sweep to A’s
articles.description: In the best start of his career, Bryan Woo allowed only one hit over eight dominant innings, helping the Mariners avoid an embarrassing four-game sweep to the Athletics.

articles.title: Julio Rodríguez’s clutch homer powers Mariners to big win over Rangers
articles.description: Julio Rodríguez has been searching for answers at the plate. On Thursday, he found it, with a clutch 3-run homer in the seventh inning to help the Mariners take down the Rangers.

articles.title: Mariners’ Bryce Miller, Eduard Bazardo struggle again in loss to Rangers
articles.description: Lazaro Montes’ three-run homer got the Mariners back into the game, but the good vibes that were building in the stands and in the M's dugout were fleeting Tuesday night.

articles.title: Mariners promote top hitting prospect Michael Arroyo
articles.description: Their playoff hopes all but dead, the Mariners made a clear move for the future Sunday by promoting top hitting prospect Michael Arroyo from Triple-A Tacoma.
